services_heading: Complete Patio & Landscaping Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: From initial design through to finished installation, we create outdoor spaces that add genuine value to your home.

services.title: Block Paving Patios
services.desc: Durable, attractive block paved patios tailored to your garden layout. We lay all types of blocks with proper drainage and a 10-year warranty on workmanship.

services.title: Natural Stone Paving
services.desc: Premium sandstone, slate, and porcelain paving for a high-end garden finish. Perfect for creating elegant entertaining spaces that age beautifully.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke garden design service including 3D visualisations before work begins. We ensure your layout makes sense for both aesthetics and practical use.

services.title: Driveways & Pathways
services.desc: Block paved driveways and garden pathways that improve kerb appeal and add real value to your property. Built to handle regular traffic for years.

services.title: Decking & Raised Beds
services.desc: Timber and composite decking with integrated raised planting beds. Creates multi-level garden interest and makes year-round entertaining easier.

services.title: Landscape Features
services.desc: Water features, retaining walls, planting schemes, and garden lighting. We integrate hardscaping with soft landscaping for cohesive outdoor design.

about_pullquote: I started this business to prove that a quality garden doesn't have to cost the earth.
about_para_1: Creative Patios and Landscaping has been transforming Southampton gardens for over a decade. We began as a small paving specialist and have grown into a full-service landscape design and build company. Every project starts with a detailed site visit and design consultation — we listen to what you want and turn it into reality.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we're hands-on. We don't outsource; our own experienced team handles everything from groundworks through to planting and finishing touches. We pride ourselves on honest quotes, no hidden costs, and work that's finished to your exact specification.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolutely transformed our back garden. The team arrived on time, explained everything as they went, and the finished patio looks stunning. We've already had three neighbours asking for their number. Top job.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a free consultation and 3D design drawn up within a week. The lads did the groundworks and paving in five days with minimal disruption. Really professional and didn't leave us with a mountain of mess to clean. Brilliant value for money.
reviews.author: Helen W.

reviews.text: Initially thought patio costs would be eye-watering, but their quote was competitive and they were flexible on payment. Finished in time for our summer party. Can't recommend them enough.
reviews.author: David P.
